name: PatriotGRiMM Kristo Grimm
review: Absolutely enjoyed my stay, the staff are Kind and helpful. I would definitely stay here again.

name: Dave Oman
review: I gave this hotel high marks, not because it is at all luxery, but is was surprisingly good for a budget hotel. My room appeared recently renovated, clean, and had a comfortable bed, a refrigerator, microwave, good AC, large desk to work at, and an early check-in time. A great Mexican restaurant is a 5 minute walk away.

name: Jack Elder
review: Excellent stay with great rooms ammenties! we will be coming back

name: Paula Townsend
review: I can’t say enough about this place and the kindness they showed. Above and beyond my expectations. Yes, rooms are a little older but very clean and comfortable with what you need. They treat you like family! 5* rating and 👍🏻👍🏻 Thank you again for your kindness.
safety: Very quiet and I felt safe.

name: Christen Young
review: The people that work the desk are the greatest! They are always so nice!
